ITEM 1 | Long thin spears, bright green with slightly darker tips, smooth surface, moderately tender and holding shape, cut ends pale, roughly 15-18 cm long and about 1 cm thick, grouped in a bundle on the left side of the plate covering about 15% of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Granular grain mixture, tan to light brown with darker flecks, loose and crumbly, individual bits about 2-5 mm, mounded in a pile about 8 cm across and 1.5 cm high, sitting beside the spears and under the slice to its right | 110
ITEM 3 | Wedge of flatbread-style pizza slice, golden-brown crust with charred blisters on the edge, topped with melted pale yellow cheese with browned spots over red-orange tomato sauce, one slice about 12 cm long and 2 cm thick, covering about 15% of the plate in the upper right | 140
ITEM 4 | Sliced white meat pieces, pale cream interior with golden-brown seared edges and light grill marks, moist-looking, firm, cut into strips about 1 cm thick and 6-8 cm long, stacked in an overlapping pile in the lower right corner covering about 15% of the plate | 130
